rules.title: No InnerHTML / DangerouslySetInnerHTML
rules.check: Avoid direct DOM injection to prevent XSS.
rules.good_example:
{userInput}
// If HTML is absolutely required, use a sanitizer:

rules.title: No Console Logs in Production
rules.check: Remove console.log statements. They leak sensitive data and clutter output.

rules.title: No Eval or Function Constructor
rules.check: Do not use eval() or new Function().
rules.good_example:
// Parse data safely
const result = JSON.parse(userInput);

rules.title: No Secrets in Client Code
rules.check: API keys, tokens, and secrets MUST NOT exist in frontend bundles. Use backend proxies.

rules.title: Secure Cookie Handling
rules.check: Cookies MUST use Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite=Strict attributes for sensitive data.
rules.bad_example: document.cookie = `session=${token}`; // Accessible to XSS, sent over HTTP

rules.title: No Sensitive Data in LocalStorage
rules.check: Sensitive data (tokens, PII) MUST NOT be stored in localStorage. Use httpOnly cookies.
rules.bad_example:
localStorage.setItem("authToken", token); // XSS can steal this
localStorage.setItem("creditCard", cardNumber);

rules.title: PostMessage Validation
rules.check: postMessage handlers MUST validate origin before processing messages.

rules.title: URL Parameter Injection
rules.check: User-controlled values in URLs MUST be encoded. Never interpolate raw input into href or src.
rules.bad_example:
const url = `https://api.example.com/search?q=${userInput}`; // Injection risk
link.href = userInput; // javascript: URLs possible!

rules.title: CSP Compliance
rules.check: Code MUST be CSP-compatible. No inline scripts, no unsafe-eval. Use nonces if dynamic scripts required.

rules.title: Dependency Audit
rules.check: npm audit MUST pass with zero high/critical vulnerabilities before deployment.
rules.bad_example:
# Ignoring vulnerabilities
npm audit # Shows 5 critical vulnerabilities
npm run deploy # Deploying anyway
rules.good_example:
# CI/CD pipeline
npm audit --audit-level=high
# Fails build if high/critical found

# Regular maintenance
npm audit fix
npm update
